machine_boundary: App-owned installation and Codex-visible exposure policy. OPL Framework owns install/sync producers, generated family surfaces, action execution, and read models. Domain agents own skill semantics, domain handlers, action/stage truth, quality verdicts, and artifact authority.

policy_scope: which installer surfaces must expose progress
which App user path surfaces hide skill/plugin mechanics
which Codex-visible companion entries are expected after App-managed setup
which release gates prove the policy

canonical_metadata_sources.policy: App, CLI, plugin-packaged skills, direct skills, and product-entry surfaces must consume the same domain-owned action/stage metadata instead of maintaining parallel semantic maps.

exposure_classes.brand_role: shared runtime fabric for OPL capability modules, not a user-facing brand module

installer_model.windows_online_command: download install-docker-webui.ps1 from raw.githubusercontent.com and run with -Yes

cloud_deployment_model.reverse_proxy: Caddy automatic HTTPS in front of the WebUI container

rows.one_click_install: Run the one-click installer to create compose.yaml, data/projects directories, and start the WebUI image.
rows.browser_webui: Open http://localhost:3000/ or the administrator-provided WebUI URL.
rows.access_key_settings: Enter access keys in the WebUI first-run Access panel or Settings -> Access.
rows.runtime_proxy: The WebUI configures Codex through /api/opl-runtime/configure-codex using stdin transport.
rows.startup_recovery: If startup fails, collect the redacted startup diagnostics and rerun after the Docker, port, image, or data issue is fixed.
rows.data_preservation: Keep host OnePersonLab/data and OnePersonLab/projects mounted and preserved across image/container replacement.
rows.host_update: Update the WebUI image from the host by rerunning the installer or using its explicit update mode; the browser WebUI must not self-update containers through a Docker socket.

ordinary_user_status.image_seed_selection: Default stable image must use the WebUI full seed; --tag and --image are explicit advanced overrides.

status_surfaces: OPL maintenance status after WebUI opens

image_update_model.currentness_claim_policy: remote digest comparison is status-only; it does not prove release readiness, live latest, or that a host update was applied

runtime_distribution_model.rule: Docker/WebUI presents a browser-first install experience; image updates and OPL-managed runtime/module updates are separate planes, and user state remains in mounted host directories.

first_run_user_presentation.primary_message: One Person Lab is preparing Codex and the workspace.

duplicate_prevention: plugin-packaged MAS/MAG/RCA skills must not be mirrored into duplicate bare skill directories
OPL Meta Agent is surfaced as an OPL-generated local Codex plugin surface
App visible companion skill defaults must be product profile configuration, not shell-local hardcoding

agent_registry_policy.policy_surface: Settings Capabilities registry discovery, manifest URL install entry, and package receipt display

package_manager_lifecycle.policy_surface: Settings Capabilities package manager and app/cli action receipts
package_manager_lifecycle.rollback_boundary: agent_package_lifecycle_does_not_define_an_app_or_framework_package_lifecycle_rollback_verb; App displays receipt rollback_ref fail-closed state and repair/update route, while true managed rollback stays with managed_update_plane/runtime substrate/package-channel owners

third_party_manual_source_policy.validation_scope: validate manifest shape, plugin manifest, required skill entries, source digest, remote/distribution payload refs, trust tier, and rollback ref without hardcoding exact third-party package ids

atomic_bundle_policy.framework_local_payload_validation: repo_plugin_skill sources must resolve to .codex-plugin/plugin.json plus skills/<required_skill_id>/SKILL.md; opl_generated_plugin_surface sources must resolve to the domain pack compiler input and generated_surface_owner=one-person-lab
atomic_bundle_policy.required_skill_pack_lock_policy: skill_packs[].lock_ref must be a release or digest lock and must not equal registry.latest_version or a moving tag

plugin_registration_validation_inputs.codex_skills_root_validation_scope: fail if med-autoscience, med-autogrant, redcube-ai, or opl-bookforge exists as a bare Codex skill mirror at <codex_skills_root>/<codex_visible_entry>/SKILL.md

must_verify: non-blocking companion skill and plugin maintenance
Codex-visible MAS/MAG/RCA/OMA entries without duplicate semantics

runtime_substrate_auto_update.brand_role: shared runtime fabric for OPL capability modules, not a MAS/MAG/RCA/OMA/OBF/MAS Scholar Skills brand module

environment_materializer.role: materialize module-declared sandbox-like runtime environments from managed App-owned materials
environment_materializer.env_cache_and_isolated_prefix: module-specific managed env roots and package cache under the App-owned runtime/state root
